title: Neurotensin signaling in analgesia: Receptor mechanisms, targeted drug development, and therapeutic prospects for pain and comorbid depression
title_zh: 神经调素信号在镇痛中的作用：受体机制、靶向药物开发及疼痛和合并抑郁的治疗前景
abstract: Opioids are effective for severe pain but are limited by adverse effects and the risk of opioid use disorder (OUD), while non-opioid analgesics may provide insufficient relief. Neurotensin (NT), an endogenous neuropeptide, has attracted interest as a potential analgesic, with encouraging findings mainly from preclinical studies. This review summarizes advances in NT-based analgesic development, focusing on the pain-modulatory mechanisms of NTSR1 and NTSR2, the two principal neurotensin G protein-coupled receptors recognized by IUPHAR/BPS, and receptor-directed drug-design strategies. Sortilin, historically termed NTSR3 in some literature, is discussed separately because it is structurally distinct from these GPCRs. We examine NT-derived ligands, opioid-NT bifunctional compounds such as BNT-12, and combination approaches involving NT and opioid therapies. Their potential benefits are considered alongside safety concerns and translational limitations, including opioid-related adverse effects and pruritus. Although preclinical studies suggest promising analgesic effects, the comparative safety advantages of these strategies remain unestablished. NT may also influence mood regulation, making it relevant to the frequent co-occurrence of chronic pain with depression and anxiety. Overall, receptor-selective, multitarget, and combination approaches based on NT may offer complementary strategies for treating pain and associated affective symptoms. Further research is needed to establish their efficacy, safety, and clinical applicability, including whether they can reduce adverse effects and abuse liability.
abstract_zh: 阿片类药物对严重疼痛有效，但受限于不良反应和阿片类使用障碍（OUD）的风险，而非阿片类镇痛药可能提供的止痛不足。神经调素（NT）是一种内源性神经肽，因其潜在的镇痛作用而受到关注，主要来自预临床研究。本综述总结了基于神经调素的镇痛药物开发进展，重点介绍了IUPHAR/BPS认可的两种主要神经调素G蛋白偶联受体NTSR1和NTSR2的疼痛调节机制，以及受体导向的药物设计策略。历史上被称为NTSR3的排卵素，因其与这些GPCRs结构不同，单独讨论。我们考察了NT源配体、类似BNT-12的阿片类-NT双功能化合物，以及涉及NT和阿片类治疗的联合策略。在考虑其潜在益处的同时，也讨论了安全问题和转化局限性，包括阿片类相关的不良反应和瘙痒。尽管预临床研究表明具有前景的镇痛效果，但这些策略的比较安全优势尚未确立。NT可能还影响情绪调节，使其与慢性疼痛常见的抑郁和焦虑共病相关。总体而言，基于NT的受体选择性、多靶点和联合方法可能为治疗疼痛及相关情感症状提供互补策略。需要进一步研究以确立其疗效、安全性和临床适用性，包括它们是否能降低不良反应和滥用潜力。
